title: 第33章 别拦着，我要砍了他！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚完结版免费阅读
content_zh: 孙有道简直难以置信，搞不清楚这是什么原理。亲几下，摸几下，然后一个没有脉搏没有呼吸，几乎已经认定死亡的人，竟然奇迹般活了？不用针？不用药？也能治病？“陛下，这……这小子是何方神圣，竟然有这种本事？”孙有道缓缓转头看向炎文帝，咽了咽口水问道。还好刚才皇帝没有同意让他下车救治，不然非出大问题不可。“何方神圣？哼，不过是个自以为是的兔崽子罢了！”炎文帝冷哼，但嘴角怎么也压不住。啧啧，这小子对公主又摸又亲的，要不招为婿算了？想到这种可能性，炎文帝还是下意识地摇头，将这个念头掐灭。唐逸他有大用，将来磨练出来肯定是大炎重臣，这一点他相信自己的眼光，要是做了驸马就不能有太大的权力，只会限制他的成长。而且，澜儿这丫头已经病入膏肓，能拖多久还是个未知数……“陛下，我能见见这小兄弟吗？臣很想知道这到底怎么回事。”孙有道搓着双手，激动问道。炎文帝睨了他一眼，道：“想要见唐逸没问题，不过今日之事记得保密，朕不想在外面听到只言片语。”哼，让那群御史知道这件事，什么蔑视皇族，轻薄公主，无视皇威……无数种罪名，能生生将唐逸千刀万剐。这些御史，贼讨厌了。……胭脂楼中，萧澜惊慌失措，但看到孔诗岚，她总算是平静了一些。“岚姐，他亲我，他还摸我，他耍流氓。”萧澜指着唐逸，一边擦着嘴一边鼓着腮帮子道：“抓住他，本宫要杀了他，本宫要将他千刀万剐。”“呜呜……岚姐，我不干净了，怎么办呀？”唐逸：“……”唐逸脸都黑了，我是在救你好吧？什么叫亲你摸你，我那是做心肺复苏，哪里是在耍流氓了？再说那最后胸前那一下怪我吗？本来我想收手的，你这一动我才不小心摸到的……不过还挺大，一只手竟然掌不完。“那还真惨了，亲了不干净了，过几天就有小宝宝了，太可怕了。”唐逸从地上爬起来，抬手拍了拍屁股上的泥土。一听这话，萧澜顿时瞪大双眼，吓得脸都白了。“唐逸，你吓唬她干嘛？”孔诗岚气得咬牙切齿，这混账，得了便宜还卖乖。她连忙安抚萧岚，道：“澜儿，别听她胡说八道，亲一下不会有宝宝的……而且，他是在救你。”“虽然不知道是怎么回事，但你刚才没有了脉搏和呼吸，如果不是他……他亲你摸你，后果无法想象。”孔诗岚也搞不懂怎么回事，难道公主是被这家伙非礼，羞愤醒来的？“澜姐，你别安慰我了，我知道你是在安慰我。”萧澜眼泪簌簌而落，美眸死死盯着唐逸：“我知道的，皇姐被驸马亲了一下，皇姐就有宝宝了。”“他亲了我，还摸了我，我也会有宝宝……”“我要让父皇杀了他，我是公主，他敢玷污我。”唐逸目瞪口呆。他本来就想回怼一下这个不知好歹的女人而已，却没想到这个女人竟然还当真了？她多大了？十八岁总有了吧？十八岁了还不知男女之事？孔诗岚恶狠狠瞪着唐逸，道：“混账，你满意了？”“她自幼病弱，一直单独修养，除了陛下，她见过的男人就没几个。”“连教她读书识字的先生都是女先生，她哪里知道这些事？”唐逸无语，也就是说……这个女人这方面，就是一张白纸。他摸了摸鼻，求助看向孔诗岚，那你安慰安慰呗。结果孔诗岚也是俏脸难看，安慰？怎么安慰？男女之事萧澜是一张白纸，她懂的也只是一点皮毛啊！像这种事，那都是出嫁前夜嬷嬷才教的。“咳咳，好了，你别哭了。”唐逸只好亲自上阵，道：“我刚才就是吓唬你而已，亲一下不会怀孕，睡一起才有可能会怀孕……总之这个问题很复杂！”“现在你先别纠结这事，重要的是，你这病，我能治。”“治好了，你和正常人没什么区别，可以想做自己的事，到时候你自己去探究去！”孔诗岚，萧澜几乎瞬间抬起头：“真的？！”萧澜的病，太医说是不治之症。不是咳死，就是还在咳死的路上，等将内脏都咳碎了，她也就死了。现在，唐逸竟然说自己能治？砰！胭脂楼外，炎文帝听完汇报，再度猛地站了起来，脑袋再度重重砸在车顶。这一次却感觉到疼了，他捂着脑袋坐了下来，却激动得浑身都在轻微颤抖。女儿的病一直是他的心病，这些年遍访了天下多少名医，得到的结论都只有一个……无药可救！现在，唐逸这小子竟然说他能治疗。炎文帝几乎瞬间就相信了唐逸，他刚刚不就已经救醒澜儿了？孙有道目瞪口呆，指着胭脂店内的唐逸说不出话来。他能治疗肺痨？开什么玩笑！这个他们无数大夫都攻克不了的难题，在这少年口中竟然如此不值一提？“真的，弄点液态青霉素，应该会有效果。”唐逸瞅着震惊的孔诗岚和公主，道：“不过，我需要尝试培养一下青霉菌，大概需要半个月……也就是说，你还需要咳嗽半个月左右吧！”制作青霉素，虽然有难度，但能克服。无非就是一些设备有点难搞，不过可以将图画出来，让古代的琉璃厂家烧制出来。实在不行，他也可以试着自己烧。前世身为顶级全能兵王，被人称作地狱杀神的存在，这些都是他平日里自己研究掌握的基本技能而已。“才半个月？”孔诗岚和萧澜相视一眼，面上都激动无比。特别是萧澜，大眼睛还挂着泪珠，却已经死死抱着孔诗岚又蹦又跳了。她都咳了好几年了，不介意多咳半个月。“你……你要能治好我，我就不杀你了。”片刻，萧澜抚摸着自己的小腹，道：“虽然你这人很讨厌，但要是有了宝宝，本宫就勉为其难接受你做爹吧！”唐逸嘴角抽了抽，我谢谢你啊！这女人……这特妈什么脑回路啊？唐逸转身就走，还差点被门框给绊倒了。“哈哈……笨蛋，这都能被吓到，你刚才的本事呢？”萧澜掐着腰，冷哼。孔诗岚也是掩唇而笑，看来不仅仅是澜儿在感情上是白痴，这家伙也强不到哪里去。铮铮！然而。唐逸刚出胭脂楼，两把刀便挡在了他的前方。周围更是有数十人围了过来，将他重重包围。唐逸这才注意到，这些人不是之前的护卫，而是穿着飞鱼服，腰挎绣春刀锦衣卫。锦衣卫，那可是直属皇帝的机构啊！
content_en: Sun Youdao was in disbelief and couldn't figure out the principle of this.A few kisses and touches, and then a person who had no pulse or breathing, and was almost considered dead, miraculously survived?No need for needles?No medicine?Can it also cure diseases?"Your Majesty, this... who is this kid? He has such ability?" Sun Youdao slowly turned his head to look at Emperor Yan Wen, swallowed his saliva and asked.Fortunately, the emperor didn't agree to let him get out of the car for treatment, otherwise there would have been a big problem."Who is this? Humph, he's just a self-righteous brat!" Emperor Yan Wen snorted coldly, but he couldn't hold back the corners of his mouth.Tsk tsk, this guy touches and kisses the princess so much, why don't we just recruit him as his son-in-law?Thinking of this possibility, Emperor Yan Wen still shook his head subconsciously and extinguished the idea.Tang Yi was of great use, and he would definitely become an important minister of the Great Yan Dynasty in the future. He believed in his own vision. If he became the consort, he would not have too much power, and it would only limit his growth.Moreover, this girl Lan'er is already terminally ill, and it is unknown how long it will last... "Your Majesty, can I see this little brother? I really want to know what is going on." Sun Youdao rubbed his hands and asked excitedly.Emperor Yan Wen glanced at him and said: "It's okay to see Tang Yi, but remember to keep today's matter a secret. I don't want to hear a few words outside." Hum, let those censors know about this, such as contempt for the royal family, contempt for the princess, disregard of the emperor's power... there are countless crimes that can kill Tang Yi with a thousand knives.These censors are disgusting....In Rouge Tower, Xiao Lan panicked, but when she saw Kong Shilan, she finally calmed down."Sister Lan, he kissed me, he touched me, he acted like a gangster." Xiao Lan pointed at Tang Yi, wiping his mouth and puffing out his cheeks and said: "Catch him, I will kill him, I will cut him into pieces." "Uuu...Sister Lan, I am not clean anymore, what should I do?" Tang Yi: "..." Tang Yi's face turned dark, I am saving you, okay?What does kissing and touching you mean? I was doing cardiopulmonary resuscitation. How could I be acting like a hooligan?Besides, do you blame me for that last blow on your chest?I originally wanted to stop, but I accidentally touched it when you moved... But it's quite big, and I can't even hold it with one hand."That's really tragic. The kiss won't be clean. In a few days, there will be a baby. It's terrible." Tang Yi got up from the ground and raised his hand to pat the dirt on his butt.Upon hearing this, Xiao Lan's eyes suddenly widened and his face turned pale with fright."Tang Yi, why are you scaring her?" Kong Shilan was so angry that she gritted her teeth. This bastard still behaved after getting an advantage.She quickly comforted Xiao Lan and said: "Lan'er, don't listen to her nonsense. You won't have a baby if you kiss her... and he is saving you." "Although I don't know what happened, you just lost your pulse and breathing. If it weren't for him... if he kissed you and touched you, the consequences would be unimaginable." Kong Shilan didn't understand what was going on. Could it be that the princess was molested by this guy and woke up in shame and anger?"Sister Lan, please stop comforting me. I know you are comforting me." Xiao Lan shed tears and stared at Tang Yi with her beautiful eyes: "I know, the emperor's sister was kissed by the consort, and the emperor's sister will have a baby." "He kissed me and touched me, and I will have a baby..." "I want my father to kill him, I am a princess, and he dares to taint me." Tang Yi was stunned.He originally wanted to retaliate against this ungrateful woman, but he didn't expect that this woman would actually take it seriously?How old is she?You have to be eighteen years old, right?You are eighteen years old and you still don’t know anything about men and women?Kong Shilan glared at Tang Yi fiercely and said, "Bastard, are you satisfied?" "She has been sick since she was a child and has been cultivating alone. Apart from Your Majesty, she has met few men." "Even the gentleman who taught her reading and literacy was a female gentleman. How did she know these things?" Tang Yi was speechless, which means... this woman is just a blank sheet of paper.He touched his nose and looked at Kong Shilan for help, please comfort him.In the end, Kong Shilan also had a pretty face but looked ugly. Comfort?How to comfort?Xiao Lan is a blank sheet of paper when it comes to matters between men and women, and she only knows a little bit about it!Things like this were taught by grandma on the eve of the wedding."Ahem, okay, don't cry." Tang Yi had no choice but to go into battle in person and said, "I was just scaring you. You won't get pregnant if you kiss, but you can get pregnant if you sleep together... In short, this issue is very complicated!" "Don't worry about it now, it's important.Yes, I can cure your disease." "After it's cured, you can do your own thing.Then you can explore it yourself!" Kong Shilan, Xiao Lan raised her head almost instantly: "Really?" The imperial doctor said that Xiao Lan's disease is incurable.Either she coughed to death, or she was still coughing to death. When her internal organs were coughed up, she would die.Now, Tang Yi actually said that he can cure it?Bang!Outside Rouge Tower, after listening to the report, Emperor Yanwen stood up suddenly again and hit his head heavily on the roof of the car again.This time, he felt pain. He covered his head and sat down, but his whole body was shaking slightly with excitement.His daughter's illness has always been a concern for him. He has visited many famous doctors around the world over the years, but they all come to the same conclusion... there is no cure!Now, this guy Tang Yi actually said that he could treat it.Emperor Yanwen believed Tang Yi almost instantly. Didn't he just rescue Lan'er?Sun Youdao was stunned, pointing at Tang Yi in the Rouge shop and speechless.Can he cure tuberculosis?What a joke!This problem that countless of their doctors have been unable to overcome is so unworthy of mention in this young man's mouth?"Really, getting some liquid penicillin should be effective." Tang Yi looked at the shocked Kong Shilan and the princess and said, "However, I need to try to cultivate Penicillium, which will take about half a month... In other words, you still need to cough for about half a month!" Making penicillin is difficult, but it can be overcome.It's just that some of the equipment is a bit difficult to get, but you can draw out the pictures and let the ancient glaze manufacturers bake them.If that doesn't work, he can try burning it himself.In his previous life, he was a top all-round soldier and was known as the God of Hell. These were just the basic skills he studied and mastered on his own."Only half a month?" Kong Shilan and Xiao Lan looked at each other with excitement on their faces.Especially Xiao Lan, whose big eyes were still filled with tears, but she was already jumping up and down holding Kong Shilan tightly.She has been coughing for several years and doesn't mind coughing for half a month longer."You...if you can cure me, I won't kill you."
